NOTIFICATION.Subject: Decomm. sequence initiated by for &SERVER# by user &USER#

SCRIPT.MSCRI:
:set &USER# = sys_user_name()
! generate message content ! :set &dataSrc# = &buffer# :set &N# = uc_crlf() :set &lineLen# = 60 :set &padded# = ' ' :set &title1# = "Object name" :set &title2# = "Count" : set &padded# = str_pad(&title1#, , &lineLen#, "LEFT") :put_att_append CALL_TEXT = "&padded#&title2#&N#"
:set &hnd# = prep_process_var(&dataSrc#) :process &hnd# : set &title1# = get_process_line(&hnd#,1) : set &title2# = get_process_line(&hnd#,2) : set &padded# = str_pad(&title1#, "_", &lineLen#, "LEFT") : put_att_append CALL_TEXT = "&N#&padded#&title2#" : set &len# = str_lng(&padded#) : p "&padded#&title2#" :endprocess

! insert these lines in your script to determine if an error occurred ! ! @set retcode=%errorlevel% ! @if NOT %ERRORLEVEL% == 0 goto :retcode
powershell -Command "(gc &export_path#uc_export_decomm_&flow_rnr#.xml) -replace '<Active>1</Active>', '<Active>0</Active>' | Out-File -encoding ASCII &export_path#ps_out_&flow_rnr#.xml"

: set &exportPath# = "&export_path#uc_export_decomm_&flow_rnr#.xml" : set &export# = export("VGF_DECOMM/TO_BE_DEACTIVATED",&exportPath#) : set &catch# = sys_last_err_ins() : if &catch# ne "" : set &errNr# = sys_last_err_nr() : set &errTxt# = get_msg_txt(&errNr#, &catch#) : p &errTxt# : exit 6 : endif

!:read &SERVER#, , "Name of Agent to be searched for.", , M ! Create or prepare buffer
:if get_oh_idnr(&buffer#)= 0 : set &create# = CREATE_OBJECT("VARA", &buffer#, "VGF", "Temporary buffer to keep found objects (VGF)", "I", "C", "FREE") : set &catch# = sys_last_err_ins() : if &catch# ne "" : set &errNr# = sys_last_err_nr() : set &errTxt# = get_msg_txt(&errNr#, &catch#) : p &errTxt# : exit 5 : endif :endif
:set &max_rows#= get_var(UC_SYSTEM_SETTINGS, SQLVAR_MAX_ROWS) :p &max_rows# :set &varHnd# = prep_process_var(SQLI_FIND_USAGE_COUNT) :if &max_rows# = get_process_info(&varHnd#, ROWS) : p "Looks like you have more results that the allowed limit. Consider increasing 'SQLVAR_MAX_ROWS'" :endif
:process &varHnd# : set &job_name# = GET_PROCESS_LINE(&varHnd#, 2) : set &usage# = GET_PROCESS_LINE(&varHnd#, 3) : p "&job_name#(&usage#)" : put_var &buffer#, &job_name#, &usage# :endprocess

: set &importFile# = "ps_out_&flow_rnr#.xml" : set &import# = import("&export_path#&importFile#","VGF_DECOMM",1,1) : set &catch# = sys_last_err_ins() : if &catch# ne "" : set &errNr# = sys_last_err_nr() : set &errTxt# = get_msg_txt(&errNr#, &catch#) : p &errTxt# : exit 6 : endif
:RESTART MOVE, "Move deactivated objects"
:set &varHnd# = prep_process_var(&buffer#) :process &varHnd# : set &object# = get_process_line(&varHnd#, 1) : set &move# = move_object(&object#, "VGF_DECOMM/TO_BE_DELETED") : set &catch# = sys_last_err_ins() : if &catch# ne "" : set &errNr# = sys_last_err_nr() : set &errTxt# = get_msg_txt(&errNr#, &catch#) : p &errTxt# : exit 6 : else : set &text# = str_pad(&object#, , 60, "LEFT") : p "INFO: &text#Ready to be deleted!" : endif :endprocess

:set &varHnd# = prep_process_var(&buffer#) :process &varHnd# : set &object# = get_process_line(&varHnd#, 1) : set &move# = move_object(&object#, "VGF_DECOMM/TO_BE_DEACTIVATED") : set &catch# = sys_last_err_ins() : if &catch# ne "" : set &errNr# = sys_last_err_nr() : set &errTxt# = get_msg_txt(&errNr#, &catch#) : p &errTxt# : exit 6 : else : set &text# = str_pad(&object#, , 60, "LEFT") : p "INFO: &text#Ready to be deactivated!" : endif :endprocess

HEADER.Title: Temporary buffer to keep found objects (VGF)
Search objects using the host in attributes

SQLI.command.sql: SELECT oh.oh_name, COUNT(jpp.jpp_object) AS object_count FROM oh LEFT JOIN jba ON oh.oh_idnr = jba.jba_oh_idnr LEFT JOIN jfa ON oh.oh_idnr = jfa.jfa_oh_idnr LEFT JOIN oea ON oh.oh_idnr = oea.oea_oh_idnr LEFT JOIN jpp ON oh.oh_name = jpp.jpp_object WHERE oh.oh_client = ? AND oh.oh_otype IN ( 'JOBS', 'JOBF', 'EVNT' ) AND ( jba.jba_hostdst = ? OR jfa.jfa_hostdst = ? OR jfa.jfa_hostsrc = ? OR oea.oea_hostdst = ? ) GROUP BY oh.oh_name;
